purpose: Remote Desktop Protocol for Windows GUI access.
description: Proprietary protocol developed by Microsoft, which provides a user with a graphical interface to connect to another computer.
real_world_incidents: Primary initial access vector for countless ransomware campaigns targeting Windows domains.
recommended_actions: Place behind a VPN or RD Gateway.

audience_guidance.student: RDP lets you control a Windows PC remotely. Leaving it open to the internet is a common way hackers spread ransomware.
audience_guidance.developer: Ensure Network Level Authentication (NLA) is required. Never expose 3389 directly to the internet.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Check for NLA status. If NLA is disabled, the server is much more vulnerable to exploitation.
audience_guidance.pentester: Check for BlueKeep vulnerability. Brute force credentials. Use Nmap scripts to check supported encryption levels.
audience_guidance.security_team: Block 3389 at the perimeter. Require VPN or Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) for RDP. Enforce MFA via Duo or similar.
